name: INABULETWO 4-in-1 Multifunctional Pet Hair Remover Tool
description: INABULETWO 4-in-1 manual pet hair remover tool for furniture, carpets, and clothes. Features an extendable 17.3-inch ergonomic handle and a 7.3-inch wide dual-action brush head to effortlessly lift cat and dog fur. Reusable and washable design with gentle polyester bristles that trap floating hair without stripping fabric. Eco-friendly alternative to disposable lint rollers. Excellent condition. Selling for cheap as part of a graduation yard sale!
name_zh: INABULETWO 四合一多功能除毛刷静电粘毛器
description_zh: INABULETWO 品牌四合一家用多功能宠物除毛工具。配有 17.3 英寸加长人体工学手柄和 7.3 英寸宽双效刷头，可轻松清理沙发、床单、地毯和衣物上的猫狗毛发。采用可水洗材质，环保耐用，免去更换粘纸滤芯的麻烦，温和的静电刷面在吸附浮毛的同时保护衣物织面。状态极好，毕业搬家几美金低价打包甩卖！
